title: LRU-eviction abuse surface: eviction-clears-replay and REPLAY_PERSIST refusal untested; capacity controls needed before EDHOC-driven registration
description: peer_add is admin/dev-provisioning-only today so remote pin-flapping is unreachable, but lichen_l2_rx.c:170 commits to EDHOC/announce-driven registration, at which point an attacker controlling CONFIG_LICHEN_LINK_MAX_NEIGHBORS valid identities can fill peer+replay tables, force-evict a quiet live peer, reset its replay window, and replay captured frames into the fresh window (replay table has no LRU: replay.c:112-116 fails closed). REPLAY_PERSIST mode refuses eviction (-ENOSPC, lichen_l2_peer.c:341-347) but that refusal is untested. Spec 02 4.2 step 5 sanctions eviction semantics. Before EDHOC registration lands: per-identity admission rate limits, reserved slots, plus tests for eviction-clears-replay and persist-mode refusal.
